## About
Triple O Automotive is a family business. We founded it to proudly serve automobile owners in the Portland area, and we all grew up in love with the power and feel of vehicles. Ask about our favorites, but you might be sticking around for a while.
We bring that passion to the work we do. Our mechanics are professional, quick and careful, and we'll send you home driving a safe vehicle that meets all regulations and inspections.
Customers give us a 4.9 rating from 54 Google reviews. One reviewer told friends to ask for Spencer, and another thanked Rob for walking his family through a car purchase from out of town.

## Services
- Pre-purchase inspection: Thinking about buying a used car? We'll look it over and walk you through what we find before you commit.
- Brake work: We handle brake work so your car stops the way it should.
- Fixing oil leaks: Seeing spots under your car? We'll find the oil leak and fix it.
- AC: One customer said we got her AC running perfectly.

## FAQ
Q: Can you check out a car before I buy it?
A: Yes. We do pre-purchase inspections, and one customer said it helped them avoid a costly mistake.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Will my car be safe and ready for inspection?
A: That's the goal. We'll send you home driving a safe vehicle that meets all regulations and inspections.
